directSourceFindings: The Stage 29 verifier exercises the real workflow-engine evidence-chain calculation and project-store checkpoint mechanisms rather than using proof JSON as the behavioral oracle.
CALCULATE_EVIDENCE_CHAINS is an application command with no external response envelope; exact idempotent retry returns the existing calculated result rather than creating duplicate canonical state.
Chain completion requires structural completeness, sufficient current evidence, current release linkage, and current artifact identity; stale or weak evidence leaves the chain incomplete.
INVESTIGATE_MISSING_EVIDENCE may diagnose missing evidence but cannot manufacture canonical evidence or substitute a nonexistent backup-export event.

A generated-only or same-origin backup does not satisfy pre-delivery custody. The repaired checkpoint requires BACKUP_EXPORT_ACTION_COMPLETED evidence and exact current release/hash-review/evidence-chain/delivery-candidate/artifact binding.
Two repaired valid release fixtures complete all mandatory evidence chains and create a qualifying pre-delivery checkpoint; the same mechanisms reject the twelve targeted invalid states.
repairedStateProofs: Two independently constructed repaired Stage 29 fixtures complete all mandatory evidence chains with structuralCoverage=1 and evidenceSufficiencyCoverage=1.
The repaired checkpoint is CHECKPOINT-001 with custodyState BACKUP_EXPORT_ACTION_COMPLETED and exact covered delivery artifact ARTIFACT-DELIVERY-A.
The terminal prerequisite path accepts only the repaired evidence-bound checkpoint and continues to reserve final authorization for Controller Stage 30.
